source_title: Phantom Blade Zero: How to Beat The Gold-Masked One - GameRant
source_excerpt:
The Gold Masked One, portrayed by Donnie Yen, is one of the toughest bosses in Phantom Blade Zero that players will come across by entering the Long Pillars, which are part of the "Bloodline Awakening" quest. Players will come across the first of the five Long Pillars in the first region, the Weeping Creek Valley. While defeating this boss is optional, it's highly recommended to complete the boss fight if you're aiming to get the secret Perfect ending for Phantom Blade Zero .
Gold Masked One Boss Guide in Phantom Blade Zero
The Gold Masked One in Phantom Blade Zero isn't a conventional boss, since it functions as a brutal tutorial designed to master your defensive timing.
The boss is entirely immune to standard damage until you completely deplete his Sha-Chi gauge . To do that, you must aggressively counter his color-coded attacks : execute a parry whenever his attack flashes blue, and land a perfect dodge when his attack flashes red. Once his Sha-Chi gauge is broken, you can finally open up and inflict real damage.
Here are some examples of his attack moves, so you're better prepared to counter them accordingly.
The Gold Masked One will constantly pressure you by closing the gap with rapid kick combinations and tight sword swipes . Keep a close eye on his positioning. If he starts strafing during these close-range strings, he is baiting you. Be ready to dodge immediately because he'll try to perform a red unblockable grab move that will chew through a massive portion of your HP.
Another move he'll frequently perform is jumping into the air and spinning his sword . As soon as he does this move, he'll quickly transition into a red move to land a crushing blow on Soul. Make sure to look for the red signal and immediately perform a dodge.
When the Gold Masked One is at a distance, he'll try to charge his sword with a red aura and send projectile sword slashes towards Soul. You'll need to normally block these attacks, and be ready to press the block immediately after he closes the gap to your position and performs a blue strike.
Once the Gold Masked One's Sha-Chi gauge (yellow bar under HP) is depleted , you can start attacking him. Keep repeating the process and learn the boss' moves to finally defeat him.
Once you've defeated the boss, you'll learn more about the boss, and the Long Pillar will crumble. Players will receive the Counterstrike Bracers accessory for defeating the Gold Masked One in Phantom Blade Zero in the Weeping Creek Valley. You'll find four more Long Pillars in other regions, and they'll bring you closer to the game's Perfect ending.
Where to Find the Gold Masked One in Phantom Blade Zero
To start the boss fight with the Gold Masked One in Phantom Blade Zero , you'll first need to enter the locked area beside the Sha-Chi Tower by finding the Sha-Chi Tower Base Camp Gate key, part of the Deep in the Valley quest .
Once you're in the area, pick up the Rusted Loong Key near the Long Pillar Overlook crane bell , and use it on the door I've marked above.
Using the Rusted Loong Key to open the locked door takes you into the caverns . Keep following the path until you end up at the Long Pillar that you can interact with to start the Bloodline Awakening quest and fight the Gold Masked One boss.
